name: Agabus
bio: Agabus, a prophet, came from Jerusalem to Antioch and foretold by the Spirit a severe famine that would affect the whole world, which came to pass under Claudius Caesar; the disciples at Antioch responded by sending relief to the believers in Judea through Barnabas and Saul (Acts 11:27-30). His further prophetic role is told in detail in the chapters ahead.
